jobs.title: Director, Operational Planning
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Almost 1.2 million residents call York Region home, making it one of the largest regions in Canada – and the fastest growing with a population that’s expected to grow to more than 2 million by 2041. Our geography, which is comprised of about 1,800 square kilometers over nine different municipalities, is as beautiful, interesting and diverse as our people. Local government is organized in a two-tier structure and we work together with our local municipalities to provide residents and businesses access to a broad selection of services and resources.

WHAT WE OFFER

Consistently named one of Canada’s Best Employers by Forbes, we offer a collaborative, progressive workplace that takes pride in our organizational culture and is committed to living The 13+ Factors of Psychological Health and Safety in the Workplace – aligned with our vision to create strong, caring and safe communities both within and outside our walls.

Defined Benefit Pension Program - With the Ontario Municipality Employees Retirement System (OMERS) defined benefit pension plan, you can confidently retire knowing that you will have income for life. Eligibility from date of hire as a full-time employee and includes employer-matched contributions. Employer of Choice - Recognized as the highest-ranking government employer in Canada and fourth overall among 300 organizations.

Benefits and Wellness - Employees and their loved ones have access to a comprehensive employer-paid benefits plan that includes extended health, dental and life insurance, access to a 24/7 Employee and Family Assistance Program and corporate discounts and purchase plans for day-to-day products and services.

Inclusive and Diverse Workforce - We’re committed to fostering an environment that celebrates all dimensions of diversity and ensures everyone can develop to their full potential, participate freely in society and live with respect, dignity and freedom from discrimination. Our robust Inclusion, Diversity, Equity and Accessibility program continues to grow, and has been recognized by the United Nations and many other organizations for our leadership.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Reporting to the General Manager, Paramedic & Seniors Services, is responsible for the oversight of program planning and operational policy development for the branch including the developing and implementing a strategy for data, quality assurance and analysis needs to ensure value to drive continuous improvement processes and business decisions; man aging compliance and reporting metrics to quantify service quality standards, key performance indicators (KPI’s) and benchmarks; supporting operational divisions in the investigation of clinical performance concerns/issues; leading the development and implementation of the Paramedic & Seniors Services capital planning and delivery (asset management plans and facility maintenance) in consultation with Property Services; overseeing all contracts, agreement and procurement activities; supporting strategic planning, communication planning and budgeting for the branch; acts as Branch liaison with the Commissioner’s office on Department Strategic Planning and Performance; and overseeing branch information technology projects and on-going technology requirements in coordination with Information Technology (ITS) and Integrated Business Services (IBS) Branch.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Business/Strategic Planning, Budget and Financial Management Functions:

Responsible for the overall direction, goal and strategy setting, development of objectives, and for providing leadership oversight to policies and procedures for all of the division’s areas of business related to operational planning services.
Develops and monitors annual and multi-year branch budgets and business plans, grant application process for funding; and coordinates submission of the Branch budget with the support and guidance of the IBS and in accordance with Regional guidelines and by-laws.
Develops the division’s annual business plan, oversees implementation and monitors the action plan for achieving results, regular evaluation of targets and outcomes, taking corrective action where/when necessary and regularly reporting on progress.
Leads Branch management staff through a process of planning and developing long range objectives and continually promotes on-going management commitment to continuous improvement with respect to the division's areas of business.
Oversees preparation of branch decision documents for regional council and the Commissioner of Community and Health Services, including council reports, business cases, and briefing documents.
Coordinates Branch input into Corporate and Department strategic plans.

Data Analysis, Reporting, Quality Assurance and Performance Management Functions:

Leads Branch data strategy development and implementation in alignment with the Department and Corporate strategic initiatives
Develops and implements overarching short and long-term business plans and strategies related to data collection, analysis and metrics to ensure that data provides value add to support and drive future business decisions.
Oversees data and trend metrics, data analysis and CQI metrics required to define service trends, service gaps; utilizes data to determine the need for process reviews and process changes; and determines the applicability of data to support decision making related to programs and services.
Provides oversight to the development of reports on a variety of data analysis and metrics for senior management to support business decisions, resource needs and service delivery improvement.
Oversees the completion and submission of provincial and regional reporting requirements within the Branch
Leads the implementation of quality improvement frameworks for branch operations including quality assurance activities to monitor program effectiveness and support continuous quality improvement.
Oversees development of key program performance metrics; works with management staff to implement programs and manages performance to meet or exceed targets.
Oversees the attainment of accreditation requirements of Seniors Services with accrediting organizations and participates on provincial task force/committees or compliance reviews on issue (s) as directed.

Contracts and Procurement Management Functions:

Oversees the management of all aspects of the procurement processes and contract requirements for the Branch to ensure that all current and future goods and services requirements are met in consultation with Corporate Procurement office, IBS, Legal, Insurance & Risk and Finance.
Leads all procurement plans for the Branch and develops short / long term strategies to meet operational requirements.
Ensure adherence to the Region’s Purchasing By-law, policies and guidelines.

Capital Delivery, Asset Management and Technology Support Functions:

In partnership with the Property Services and the IBS branches, oversees the development and implementation of capital plans for Paramedic & Seniors Services facilities and in consultation with key stakeholders related to the building or replacement of Paramedic & Seniors Services facilities.
Provides oversight to the implementation of comprehensive systems and programs in the management and maintenance of branch facilities in accordance with legislation and regulations, and internal policies, including risk management and in partnership with Property Services and the Integrated Business Services (IBSB) branches.
Directs the development, implementation, and monitoring of Branch technology systems, processes and practices, including hardware/software requirements in collaboration with ITS and IBSB; liaises with vendors, consultants and provincial staff to integrate and implement communication and data base systems.
In partnership with ITS and the IBS branches, leads and manages project teams, technical and user support for the development, implementation, and evaluation of systems and related technology and network applications and voice/data communications that support programs and fleet, and makes recommendation on technology requirements.

4. Human Resource Management and Team Leadership Responsibilities:

Supervises staff, including recruitment, selection, hiring, assigning work, determining training and development needs, conducting performance appraisals and determining/recommending disciplinary action up to and including dismissal, in accordance with collective agreements, Regional policies and practices; ensures adherence to appropriate Regional HR policies and government legislation.

Communication, Liaison and Customer Service Activities:

In consultation with Strategic Department Communications, coordinates Branch internal and external branch communication planning activities
Represents the branch on negotiations with consultants, contractors, external agencies/groups, local municipalities, etc., as directed.
Chairs and/or participates on committees, task forces, working groups and special projects; represents the Region on external committees, meetings, as required.
Prepares Committee and Council reports as well as the preparation of detailed technical reports required for all processes, standards and materials required for project/program approval.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Successful completion of a University Degree in Business, Health, Public Administration, or a related discipline, or approved equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum of seven (7) years’ program planning and administration experience, including significant direct senior managerial experience that includes, capital planning and delivery, budget administration and business planning, strategic planning, policy development and implementation, procurement, and experience managing data and quality improvement initiatives, including a minimum of three (3) years’ of direct senior managerial experience that includes program, financial, budget administration and human resource management.
Demonstrated knowledge of applicable legislation, municipal and Regional government organization and structure, industry standards, issues and communities served.
Knowledge of and demonstrated ability in strategic planning, change management design, process and implementation strategies to optimize both quality and cost-effectiveness of services.
Demonstrated political acumen and ability to negotiate, mediate, facilitate and present information to a varied audience.
Knowledge of and demonstrated ability in strategic planning, change management design, process and implementation strategies to optimize both quality and cost-effectiveness of services.
Demonstrated knowledge of the provincial health care system and experience working with local health care providers.
Demonstrated knowledge and application of financial budget and business planning processes.
Strong analytical, problem solving, decision making, report writing and presentation skills.
Computer literacy in a Windows environment utilizing Microsoft Office applications.
As a condition of employment, candidates will be required to provide a satisfactory Police Vulnerable Sector Check (PVSC), tuberculosis screening and proof of immunization in accordance with the Fixing Long-Term Care Act (FLTCA), 2021.
A valid Class “G” drivers’ license, clear of serious offences under the Highway Traffic Act.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Engineering - Corporates, Financial Institutions & Sovereigns
jobs.description:
Senior Director, Engineering – Corporates, Financial Institutions & Sovereigns

Fitch Ratings

The Opportunity

Fitch Ratings is looking for a builder, a challenger, and a boundary-pusher to lead the engineering organization responsible for all applications and services powering our Corporates, Financial Institutions, and Sovereigns lines of business. This is not a role for someone who optimizes within the status quo — it's a role for someone who questions it, reimagines it, and has the courage and capability to do something about it.

As Senior Director, you will have executive ownership of four engineering teams comprising a couple of dozen engineers. You'll lead a talented, multidisciplinary group tackling some of the most consequential technology challenges in global financial intelligence — maintaining and evolving the systems that analysts and clients depend on today, while simultaneously building the next generation of platforms from a position of real creative freedom and organizational backing.

This is a role for someone who moves fast, experiments boldly, and doesn't wait for permission to try something new. Someone who has broken things in the pursuit of building something better, who sees constraints as invitations to be clever, and who brings an infectious sense of possibility that raises the ambition of everyone around them. If you've spent time deep in machine learning or AI systems — not just using them, but building them — that's not just a bonus, it's the kind of background that makes this opportunity even more compelling. But this role goes far beyond any single discipline: it's about leading a culture of relentless innovation across every dimension of how software gets built and delivered.

We'll Count on You To

Challenge the conventional and set a bolder technical vision
Own the strategic direction, execution, and engineering culture of four high-performing full-stack engineering teams. But more than managing what exists — interrogate it. Ask the uncomfortable questions about why things are built the way they are, and lead your teams toward answers that are smarter, faster, and more powerful. Set a technical vision that doesn't just improve the current state but genuinely reimagines what's possible for the platforms powering Fitch's most critical analytical work.

Build, develop, and inspire exceptional people
Lead, mentor, and empower a team of team leads and engineers across a range of technical backgrounds and experience levels. Foster a culture where intellectual curiosity is celebrated, where experimentation is encouraged, and where people feel safe enough to take risks and learn loudly from what doesn't work. Attract and retain engineers who are hungry, inventive, and proud of both the quality of what they ship today and the audacity of what they're building toward.

Reimagine and modernize critical platforms
Oversee the full lifecycle of the applications and services central to Fitch's Corporates, Financial Institutions, and Sovereigns analytical workflows. Balance the discipline of maintaining production-grade systems with the creative ambition to tear down and rebuild what no longer serves the business well. Be the person in the room who asks "what if we started over?" — and who knows when that's exactly the right call.

Drive greenfield innovation without apology
Identify and actively pursue opportunities to design and build net-new applications and platforms that replace or leapfrog legacy approaches. Embrace the blank canvas — and bring the rigor of world-class software delivery with you. This is an organization that wants to see bets placed, experiments run, and lessons learned fast. Be the kind of leader who creates that energy and channels it into things that last.

Push the frontier of AI, ML, and intelligent systems
Go beyond adopting AI tools — define how intelligent systems become structural, load-bearing parts of the platforms your teams own. Whether that's LLM-powered workflows, ML models embedded in analytical processes, agentic automation, or AI-augmented developer tooling, bring the depth to evaluate, architect, and champion these capabilities with real technical conviction. If you've built ML systems from the ground up, that experience will resonate deeply here — and you'll have the platform to apply it in genuinely high-stakes, high-visibility ways.

Influence across a complex and interconnected stakeholder landscape
Act as a strategic partner to a broad and diverse set of stakeholders — including senior leadership, analytical teams, operations, and business relationship management — whose workflows and outcomes depend directly on the platforms your teams own. Navigate a rich ecosystem of technical interdependencies, partnering with peer engineering teams whose systems integrate with, depend on, or are shaped by what your teams build. Build organizational credibility through consistent delivery, clear technical vision, and the ability to bring bold ideas to life in ways that earn trust across the business.

What You Need To Have

18+ years of hands-on software engineering experience , with substantial time in senior technical leadership roles overseeing multiple teams and disciplines
Proven multi-team leadership — demonstrated experience leading team leads and engineers across full-stack disciplines; a track record of building high-performing, inventive engineering cultures at meaningful scale
Deep technical credibility and hands-on instinct — strong command of modern software architecture, cloud-native platforms, and production-grade application delivery; you know when to go deep, and your teams and peers will know it too
Full-stack engineering expertise — proven background with modern enterprise technology stacks, including React, Java, and/or Python in production environments, deployed across AWS and/or Azure
A bias for experimentation and innovation — a demonstrable history of pushing technical boundaries, challenging inherited assumptions, and driving teams toward approaches that are meaningfully better — not just incrementally improved
Modernization and greenfield experience — proven ability to evolve existing platforms while simultaneously designing and delivering new systems; comfort making bold architectural decisions in both constrained legacy and open greenfield environments
People leadership and talent development — demonstrated ability to attract, grow, and retain exceptional engineers and engineering leaders; a builder of teams as much as systems, with a genuine investment in the growth of the people around you
Cross-functional stakeholder management — proven ability to partner effectively across analytical, operational, and business-facing teams as well as peer technical organizations; skilled at managing competing priorities and driving alignment across a complex interdependency landscape
Executive communication — the ability to translate bold technical vision for non-technical audiences, build trust through delivery, and make complex ideas land clearly at every level of the organization
Education: Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related technical field — or equivalent expertise demonstrated through impact

What Would Make You Stand Out

An ML or AI engineering background — if you've spent meaningful time building machine learning systems, training models, designing intelligent pipelines, or architecting AI-native applications, that depth is genuinely exciting for this role and will shape how you lead, what you build, and the kind of talent you attract
Deep cloud-native expertise — hands-on mastery of AWS and/or Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, microservices architecture, and sophisticated CI/CD and deployment pipelines for large-scale application delivery
Generative AI and intelligent systems experience — hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, or production ML systems; the ability to move between engineering credibility and strategic vision without losing altitude
AI-native delivery leadership — direct experience implementing AI-augmented development lifecycles, intelligent testing pipelines, or AI-assisted tooling that materially raises the quality and velocity of engineering teams
Transformation and platform modernization leadership — a history of successfully reimagining complex, production-critical platforms while maintaining delivery continuity and rallying teams around a compelling future state
A maverick streak with enterprise judgment — the rare combination of someone who genuinely challenges conventions and moves with urgency, but knows how to do it within a complex organization without losing stakeholders along the way
Financial services domain knowledge — familiarity with analytical workflows, credit ratings processes, or how technology creates leverage in financial decision-making
Technical thought leadership — contributing to open source, speaking at industry events, publishing engineering content, or establishing technical direction that influences well beyond your immediate team

What We Offer

A genuine mandate to innovate — not a talking point, but real organizational backing to question, challenge, and rebuild the platforms powering some of Fitch's most critical business lines
Executive visibility and strategic influence — direct access to senior leadership, the platform to shape engineering direction across consequential lines of business, and the opportunity to leave a lasting mark on how global financial intelligence is delivered
The intersection of depth and breadth — lead a capable, experienced engineering organization while simultaneously running a bold innovation agenda; this role sits at a genuinely rare intersection of operational accountability and creative freedom
A place where ML and AI expertise becomes architecture — if you've built intelligent systems, this is an environment where that knowledge doesn't sit on the shelf; it shapes product direction, platform design, and how the organization thinks about what's next
Cutting-edge technology and continuous learning — access to the latest AI tools, frameworks, platforms; training and conference budgets; and the expectation that you'll stay at the leading edge and pull your teams forward with you
Career acceleration at scale — high visibility to the most senior leaders at Fitch, a clear path to principal and executive roles, and the opportunity to define what AI-driven financial technology looks like in practice
A culture that rewards curiosity — an environment where bold ideas are welcomed, where experimentation is celebrated, and where the best thinking wins regardless of where it comes from

Why Fitch?

At Fitch Group, the combined power of our global perspectives is what differentiates us. Our global network of colleagues comes together to accomplish things greater than they ever could alone.

Every team member is essential to our business, and each perspective is critical to our success. We embrace a diverse culture that encourages a free exchange of ideas, guaranteeing your voice will be heard and your work will have an impact, regardless of seniority.

We are building incredible things at Fitch and we invite you to join us on our journey.

About Fitch Group

Fitch Group is a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries. Wholly owned by the Hearst Corporation, we are comprised of three main businesses: Fitch Ratings | Fitch Solutions | Fitch Learning.

For more information please visit our websites: www.fitchratings.com | www.fitchsolutions.com | www.fitchlearning.com

Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. Why Black and Veatch

Our hybrid environment allows you to balance your work and personal life. At Black & Veatch, you own your career with purpose and meaning. The Opportunity

Black & Veatch has an exciting opportunity for a Wastewater Infrastructure Planning Business Leader
based in Toronto. In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

Provide leadership for our wastewater collection planning business in the Greater Toronto Area and beyond, including supporting projects and opportunities in the USA.
Provide technical solutions and differentiation for the Collection System Planning team focused on wastewater infrastructure planning.
Evaluation of wastewater system capacity, condition, resilience, and operating efficiency.
Analysis and projections of wastewater flows.
Use of risk-based assessments to develop and prioritize capital improvement programs.
Integration of condition assessment and asset management data into system master planning and to directly support replacement & renewal planning.
Use of cutting-edge hydraulic modeling, GIS, asset management, and data visualization software to help solve client issues.
Provide project execution and technical leadership support for our planning and asset management projects.
Provide technical leadership to support marketing and business development in the GTA and beyond.
Work closely with Client Directors to leverage existing and build new relationships with clients and decision makers in the GTA and beyond.
Lead and/or support pursuit, proposal, and project interview activities.

This job posting is for establishing a newly created position.

The Team

As an employee-owned, global leader in building critical infrastructure in the energy, water, telecommunications and government services markets, Black & Veatch has a long-standing reputation for providing world-class service to our clients.

Our North American Planning & Asset Management business has seen consistent growth driven by our clients’ needs to address challenges stemming from population growth, aging infrastructure, basement flooding, system reliability and resilience concerns, the need to improve operational efficiency, and the use of “big data” to help guide decision making.  This position represents a strategic business opportunity for Black & Veatch’s Distribution & Collection System Planning team to help the company grow its market share by providing world-class wastewater infrastructure planning services.

Experience with technical and thought leadership surrounding wastewater infrastructure systems.
GTA experience in client-facing roles and with GTA Wastewater systems.
8+ years of infrastructure assessment experience including hydraulic modeling, master planning, condition assessment, asset management, and data analysis.
Experience managing planning project, leading technical tasks and project teams, and executing wastewater collection system studies and assessments that involve system operations modeling, optimization techniques, risk & resiliency evaluations, capital and life-cycle cost analyses, CIP prioritization.
Proficient with data analyses, analytics, and visualization.
Proficient with report writing and PowerPoint presentations.
Experience in developing proposals and leading technical discussions during client interviews/projects.
Experience and/or familiarity with Geographic Information System (GIS) technology and software (i.e. ArcGIS).
Capable in MSWord, MSExcel, PowerPoint.

jobs.title: (CAN) Senior Director, Digital Strategy and Media
jobs.description:
Position Summary...
The Senior Director, Digital and Media is responsible for setting and leading Walmart Canada’s enterprise growth marketing strategy across online and offline media, SEO, and customer engagement.

This role is accountable for building an integrated, full-funnel growth engine that drives customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty, and lifetime value across omni-channel and eCommerce businesses, ensuring marketing investments are aligned to core business priorities and deliver measurable impact. Operating as a senior enterprise leader, this role sets growth priorities, governs investment decisions, and establishes performance standards that guide how media and customer engagement drive business outcomes.

What You'll Do...

Define and own Walmart Canada’s holistic growth marketing strategy across Paid Media, SEO, CRM, Walmart Delivery Pass acquisition and retention, and customer lifecycle management, ensuring alignment to enterprise business priorities.
Strategic leadership across owned marketing media investments for both Store and eCommerce, as well as advertiser-funded offsite retail media programs through Walmart Connect, ensuring media strategies are aligned to Walmart Canada business objectives while delivering measurable value for advertising partners.
Set the strategic vision and operating model for Walmart Delivery Pass marketing, including member acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, and value communication, in close partnership with Product and Membership teams.
Lead customer engagement strategy across CRM channels (email, push, in-app, SMS, personalization, and others), defining lifecycle frameworks that drive frequency, retention, lifetime value, and customer advocacy.
Own enterprise SEO strategy across eCommerce, ensuring organic traffic growth complements paid media, improves efficiency, and strengthens long-term customer acquisition.
Own the enterprise measurement vision across media, CRM, SEO, and Walmart Delivery Pass, establishing KPI frameworks, attribution models, experimentation standards, and incrementality approaches that clearly quantify growth impact.
Provide executive oversight of marketing investment across paid media, lifecycle channels, and membership marketing, ensuring disciplined prioritization, trade-off decisions, and ROI optimization.
Serve as a senior marketing leader partnering with eCommerce, Merchandising, Membership, Walmart Connect, Analytics, Finance, Product, and Technology to align growth priorities, roadmaps, and investment decisions.
Leadership of multi-disciplinary internal teams and agency partners across media, customer engagement, SEO, and measurement, establishing modern operating models, performance standards, and capability roadmaps, while building strong talent pipelines and succession plans that scale with business growth.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
15+ years of progressive experience across growth marketing, media, customer engagement, or digital commerce, including senior leadership roles.
Proven experience managing directors and senior leaders across multiple marketing disciplines.
Deep expertise in paid media, SEO, CRM, lifecycle marketing, and membership-based growth models.
Strong understanding of MarTech and AdTech ecosystems, measurement, attribution, experimentation, and privacy-safe data usage.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex performance data into executive-level insights and decisions.
Experience in retail, grocery, subscription, or omni-channel environments strongly preferred.

Leadership Expectations

Respect the Individual:

Builds high-performing teams; seeks, and embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas and experiences; creates a workplace and experiences where all associates feel seen, supported and connected through culture of belonging so associates thrive and perform; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all.

Creates a discipline and focus around developing talent through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; builds the talent pipeline, fosters an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work, empowers associates and partners to act in the best interest of the customer and company, and regularly recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments; supports strategies and drives initiatives that attract and retain the best talent.

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively and cross-functionally to achieve objectives; and communicates and listens attentively, with energy and positivity to motivate, influence, and inspire commitment and action.

Acts With Integrity

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by taking action to advance opportunity, sustainability, community, and integrity (e.g., creating fair opportunities for associates and suppliers, driving local giving efforts).

Ensures that teams follow the law, our code of conduct and company policies; promotes an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns, and models our culture of non-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates and takes action, and enables others to do the same; holds self and teams accountable for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values.

Acts as an altruistic servant leader and is consistently humble, self-aware.

Serve Our Customers

Delivers expected business results while putting the customer first and consistently applying an omni-merchant mindset and acting with an Every Day Low Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers.

Adopts a holistic perspective that considers data, analytics, customer insights, and different parts of the business when making plans and implementing strategies.

Strive For Excellence

Consistently raises the bar and seeks to improve; demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; seeks feedback, asks thoughtful questions, and fosters an environment that supports learning, innovation, learning from mistakes, and intelligent risk-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks.

Drives continuous improvements, supervises the adoption of new technology, and supports digital disruption in line with Walmart’s business model.

jobs.title: Director, Business Intelligence & Category Management
jobs.description:
About Analyticsmart Consulting Inc 
Analyticsmart is a boutique analytics firm specializing in the Consumer-Packaged Goods (CPG) industry across Canada and the United States. Our mission is to transform data into meaningful, measurable, and actionable insights that drive growth and profitability for businesses. 
We empower our clients with innovative software solutions, including: 
• Merchandising App 
• CRM 
• Planogram Repository 
• Category Management 
• Data Visualization 

By leveraging cutting-edge technology, we optimize business decision-making and operational efficiency, helping brands gain a competitive advantage in the market. 
Founded in 2009, Analyticsmart has built long-lasting partnerships with global brands and retailers. With offices in Toronto, Montreal, and New York City, we are a financially prudent, bootstrapped company focused on strategic growth in larger markets. 

What Sets Us Apart? 
• Expansive bonus structure 
• Fantastic office locations in Liberty Village (Toronto), Old Town Montreal, and NYC 
• Innovative and fun work environment 
• A mix of small clients and global brands 
• A company that truly values partnership, collaboration, and dedication 

Position Summary

Analyticsmart is looking for a hands-on leader to oversee our Business Intelligence and Category Management teams. You will lead analysts and data engineers, manage key client relationships, and contribute directly to important projects.
This role suits someone who enjoys developing people and setting direction while remaining close to the work. You should be comfortable moving between a client strategy discussion, a data delivery issue, and a category insight presentation.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the team

• Manage, coach, and develop BI analysts, category analysts, and data engineers.
• Set priorities, assign work, review deliverables, and keep projects on schedule.
• Build consistent standards for analysis, data quality, reporting, and client presentations.
• Help hire and onboard team members as the department grows.
Deliver client work
• Lead BI and category management engagements from discovery through delivery.
• Work directly on complex analyses, dashboards, data projects, and category recommendations when your expertise is needed.

Appfire is seeking a Vice President, Product Management, Platform & Innovation
to lead three connected areas central to the company's next phase of growth: the Appfire Platform, the Innovation portfolio, and Appfire's technical product relationship with Atlassian.

You will define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Appfire Platform
, the shared services and AI capabilities that power our products, accelerate delivery, and create leverage across the portfolio. You will also lead the Innovation team
, responsible for discovering, validating, incubating, and launching the next generation of Appfire products.

As Appfire's senior product leader for the technical dimension of our Atlassian relationship, you will anticipate platform, API, Forge, and Marketplace changes; represent Appfire in technical and roadmap discussions; and translate ecosystem shifts into competitive advantage, product opportunity, and managed risk.

As a member of the Product Leadership Team, you will help shape strategy across the broader portfolio, translate company priorities into focused product bets, and build a high-performing team of product leaders. You will partner closely with Engineering, Go-to-Market, Finance, Legal, Security, and executive leadership.

Strategy and Portfolio Leadership

Partner with executive leadership to establish a compelling vision for the Appfire Platform and new-product portfolio as part of the broader company strategy.
Translate that vision into a clear investment thesis, product roadmap, measurable objectives, and operating plan.
Make disciplined decisions about where to build, buy, partner, invest, scale, or stop.
Maintain a clear view of progress, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs, adjusting priorities as market and business conditions change.
Communicate strategy, decisions, and outcomes clearly across executive, technical, and business audiences.

Platform Product Leadership

Treat the Appfire Platform as a product, with defined customers, value propositions, roadmaps, adoption goals, and success measures.
Define and deliver shared platform capabilities, including AI-enabled services, that increase customer value, enable revenue growth, accelerate product delivery, and reduce duplicated effort.
Drive adoption across Appfire by reducing integration friction, establishing effective rollout and migration plans, and partnering closely with product and engineering teams.
Establish metrics for platform adoption, reliability, cost efficiency, developer experience, time to market, and business impact.
Build strong feedback loops with internal product teams and other platform users to ensure the roadmap addresses their highest-value needs.
Communicate and demonstrate the value of the platform throughout the organization.

Innovation and New Growth

Lead the Innovation team in identifying, validating, incubating, and launching net-new product opportunities.
Build and actively manage a portfolio of product bets aligned with customer needs, market opportunity, and Appfire's strategic advantages.
Apply a disciplined 0-to-1 approach to customer discovery, market validation, experimentation, business-case development, and commercial launch.
Establish clear stage gates and evidence-based criteria for advancing, changing, scaling, or stopping investments.
Partner with Go-to-Market leaders on positioning, pricing, packaging, launch, and early commercial traction.
Own the path from initial concept to measurable customer adoption and revenue.
Transition validated products into the appropriate scaling organization when they are ready to move beyond incubation.

Atlassian Technical Relationship

Serve as Appfire's senior product owner for the technical dimension of the Atlassian relationship.
Represent Appfire in technical, platform, and roadmap discussions with Atlassian.
Maintain a forward-looking view of changes to Atlassian's platform, APIs, Forge architecture, Marketplace, security requirements, and developer ecosystem.
Translate ecosystem changes into product opportunities, competitive differentiation, internal readiness plans, and risk mitigation.
Influence Atlassian's technical direction where possible by clearly representing Appfire's needs, customer use cases, and strategic priorities.
Ensure relevant Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, and business teams understand upcoming changes and are prepared to respond.

People and Organizational Leadership

Lead, develop, and grow a team of product managers and product leaders responsible for the Appfire Platform and Innovation portfolio.
Set clear expectations for product strategy, customer insight, commercial thinking, execution quality, and accountability.
Recruit and retain strong product talent while building a durable leadership bench and succession pipeline.
Coach team members to take on broader and more complex product leadership responsibilities.
Establish an effective operating cadence for planning, decision-making, performance management, and cross-functional alignment.
Communicate progress, outcomes, risks, and decisions effectively at every level of the organization.

About You

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. An MBA is preferred.
10+ years of progressively responsible product management experience, including 5+ years leading teams of product managers or product leaders.
Demonstrated success defining and scaling cloud platforms, shared services, APIs, or developer-facing capabilities in a SaaS, XaaS, or consumption-based business.
Proven experience taking net-new, 0-to-1 products from discovery through launch, customer adoption, and commercial traction.
Strong technical fluency across APIs, authentication and authorization, cloud architecture, high availability, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance.
Experience translating platform investments into measurable outcomes such as revenue growth, faster time to market, increased adoption, improved productivity, lower operating cost, or greater reliability.
Commercial ownership of a significant software portfolio, including P&L, revenue, or equivalent business accountability.
Experience owning or contributing to a strategic technology-platform or partner relationship.
Strong executive judgment and communication skills, with the ability to create alignment through ambiguity, competing priorities, and complex tradeoffs.
A track record of building, coaching, and retaining high-performing product teams.

Preferred Experience

Experience building within the Atlassian ecosystem, including Forge, Marketplace, and Atlassian APIs.
Experience operating cloud services at significant scale, ideally exceeding 100 million daily service calls.
Commercial ownership of a XaaS portfolio exceeding $50 million in annual recurring revenue.
Experience building AI-enabled platform capabilities or commercial AI products.

Work in a product-first SaaS B2B environment focused on building and scaling solutions for large enterprise customers
Deliver meaningful, high-impact work that directly influences product direction and customer success

jobs.title: Global Ontology and Semantic Data Leader
jobs.description:
About The Role

Establish and lead a global ontology and semantic data strategy for the Digital Energy software organization. This role defines how products, systems, devices, points, relationships, behaviors, and operational concepts are represented consistently across the portfolio.

This is not a purely theoretical or governance-focused position. The successful candidate will combine deep semantic-technology expertise with the practical engineering ability to build and apply ontologies in real software products.

What You Will Do

Establish and lead the global ontology and semantic data strategy for DE Software.
Define a common approach to semantic modeling, entity relationships, metadata, classifications, and data tagging.
Develop practical ontologies for buildings, energy management, automation systems, and related domains.
Apply RDF, RDFS, OWL, SHACL, SPARQL, JSON-LD, and knowledge graphs where appropriate.
Establish processes for ontology development, versioning, validation, extension, and governance.
Create reusable semantic models that can be adopted across multiple products and engineering teams.
Translate operational concepts into machine-understandable models with product architects, software teams, data teams, AI teams, and domain experts.
Identify opportunities to use semantic models to improve interoperability, analytics, search, engineering efficiency, and AI capabilities.
Partner with the applied AI team to provide structured domain knowledge, grounding, and contextual relationships.
Develop reference implementations and working prototypes that demonstrate business and technical value.
Evaluate existing industry ontologies, taxonomies, schemas, and standards before creating proprietary extensions.
Build a global community of practice around ontology and semantic data.

What Will Help You Succeed

Significant professional experience with ontology engineering, semantic technologies, knowledge graphs, or closely related disciplines.
Hands-on experience designing and implementing semantic models in production or product-oriented environments.
Strong understanding of RDF, OWL, semantic relationships, controlled vocabularies, taxonomies, and data classification.
Experience with data tagging, metadata management, entity modeling, and semantic validation.
Ability to explain what an ontology is, why it matters, and how it creates value for software products and customers.
Strong software, data engineering, or technical architecture background.
Demonstrated ability to influence multiple product and engineering organizations without relying solely on direct authority.
Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in smart buildings, building management systems, industrial automation, energy management, IoT, or digital twins.
Experience with Brick Schema, Project Haystack, RealEstateCore, SAREF, BOT, or other relevant industry models.
Experience integrating semantic models with operational databases, event systems, APIs, analytics platforms, or AI applications.
Experience applying knowledge graphs or ontologies to retrieval-augmented generation, AI grounding, reasoning, or agent-based systems.
Experience leading an enterprise-wide semantic architecture or ontology program.
Familiarity with graph databases and semantic stores.

Leadership Profile

Highly articulate and able to create clarity from complex concepts.
Pragmatic rather than dogmatic.
Comfortable defining a long-term strategy while delivering near-term results.
A recognized expert who continues to work directly with technology.
Collaborative across product, architecture, engineering, and business teams.
Capable of becoming the trusted global authority for ontology within DE Software.

What Success Looks Like

Publish and align a DE Software ontology strategy.
Deliver an initial shared semantic model for a priority domain.
Create an ontology governance and versioning process.
Achieve adoption by one or more product or platform teams.
Demonstrate measurable value through an AI, interoperability, engineering, or analytics use case.
Establish a global ontology community of practice.

Working in the DE Software CTO Office

You will join a highly collaborative, global environment focused on turning emerging technologies into practical software capabilities. These positions require hands-on contributors who can create working implementations, validate ideas through engineering, and partner effectively across product, architecture, domain, and development teams.

Build strong feedback loops with internal product teams and other platform users to ensure the roadmap addresses their highest-value needs.
Communicate and demonstrate the value of the platform throughout the organization.

Innovation and New Growth

Lead the Innovation team in identifying, validating, incubating, and launching net-new product opportunities.
Build and actively manage a portfolio of product bets aligned with customer needs, market opportunity, and Appfire's strategic advantages.
Apply a disciplined 0-to-1 approach to customer discovery, market validation, experimentation, business-case development, and commercial launch.
Establish clear stage gates and evidence-based criteria for advancing, changing, scaling, or stopping investments.
Partner with Go-to-Market leaders on positioning, pricing, packaging, launch, and early commercial traction.
Own the path from initial concept to measurable customer adoption and revenue.
Transition validated products into the appropriate scaling organization when they are ready to move beyond incubation.

Atlassian Technical Relationship

Serve as Appfire's senior product owner for the technical dimension of the Atlassian relationship.
Represent Appfire in technical, platform, and roadmap discussions with Atlassian.
Maintain a forward-looking view of changes to Atlassian's platform, APIs, Forge architecture, Marketplace, security requirements, and developer ecosystem.
Translate ecosystem changes into product opportunities, competitive differentiation, internal readiness plans, and risk mitigation.
Influence Atlassian's technical direction where possible by clearly representing Appfire's needs, customer use cases, and strategic priorities.
Ensure relevant Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, and business teams understand upcoming changes and are prepared to respond.

People and Organizational Leadership

Lead, develop, and grow a team of product managers and product leaders responsible for the Appfire Platform and Innovation portfolio.
Set clear expectations for product strategy, customer insight, commercial thinking, execution quality, and accountability.
Recruit and retain strong product talent while building a durable leadership bench and succession pipeline.
Coach team members to take on broader and more complex product leadership responsibilities.
Establish an effective operating cadence for planning, decision-making, performance management, and cross-functional alignment.
Communicate progress, outcomes, risks, and decisions effectively at every level of the organization.

About You

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. An MBA is preferred.
10+ years of progressively responsible product management experience, including 5+ years leading teams of product managers or product leaders.
Demonstrated success defining and scaling cloud platforms, shared services, APIs, or developer-facing capabilities in a SaaS, XaaS, or consumption-based business.
Proven experience taking net-new, 0-to-1 products from discovery through launch, customer adoption, and commercial traction.
Strong technical fluency across APIs, authentication and authorization, cloud architecture, high availability, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance.
Experience translating platform investments into measurable outcomes such as revenue growth, faster time to market, increased adoption, improved productivity, lower operating cost, or greater reliability.
Commercial ownership of a significant software portfolio, including P&L, revenue, or equivalent business accountability.
Experience owning or contributing to a strategic technology-platform or partner relationship.
Strong executive judgment and communication skills, with the ability to create alignment through ambiguity, competing priorities, and complex tradeoffs.
A track record of building, coaching, and retaining high-performing product teams.

Preferred Experience

Experience building within the Atlassian ecosystem, including Forge, Marketplace, and Atlassian APIs.
Experience operating cloud services at significant scale, ideally exceeding 100 million daily service calls.
Commercial ownership of a XaaS portfolio exceeding $50 million in annual recurring revenue.
Experience building AI-enabled platform capabilities or commercial AI products.

What do we offer:

Work in a product-first SaaS B2B environment focused on building and scaling solutions for large enterprise customers
Deliver meaningful, high-impact work that directly influences product direction and customer success
Every Appfire team member is eligible for company equity, fostering a true sense of ownership and connection to our growth.
Employees receive 25 days of paid time off per year. After 5 years of employment, employees receive 30 days per year.
Appfire provides comprehensive coverage through Empire Health, including medical, dental, and vision insurance. Additional protection includes life insurance, critical illness coverage, accidental death and dismemberment, and long-term disability insurance.
To promote health and well-being, Appfire offers a yearly sport allowance of CAD 600, which can be used to cover the cost of various fitness or outdoor activities from gym memberships to sports equipment.
Volunteering - Every employee receives 3 fully paid days each year to participate in Appfire Town, our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) program supporting local communities.

Market recognition

Appfire has been consistently recognized for company growth, culture, corporate social responsibility, and product excellence and has been included among the Deloitte Technology Fast 500, Inc. Best Workplaces, BuiltIn Best Places to Work, and Inc. 5000. Learn more about our accomplishments, which would not be possible without our team members, partners, and customers: https://appfire.com/awards.

Equal Employer Opportunity (EEO)

Appfire is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as defined by applicable law. Our commitment extends to all employment practices, including recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination.

new_jobs.title: Head of Enterprise Services - Canada
new_jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

The Head of Enterprise Services, Canada is responsible for leading the growth, strategy, and operational delivery of the Enterprise Services (ES) business (including Managed Equipment Services) across Canada. The role combines commercial leadership, strategic direction, and operational oversight to position Siemens Healthineers as a trusted partner in delivering integrated, value-based healthcare solutions. As a key member of the leadership team, the Head of Enterprise Services, Canada will lead, and develop high-performing teams, foster a culture of accountability and innovation.

With full Profit & Loss accountability, this role drives revenue growth, expands market presence, and ensures the successful execution of innovative service offerings that deliver strong customer outcomes. This role works closely with cross-functional teams to align commercial and operational priorities, ensuring delivery excellence, regulatory compliance, and high levels of customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Responsible for the Enterprise Services (ES) Canada growth strategy and partnerships by analyzing current state of the business, identifying risks and opportunities, and developing go-to-market plans specific to the country.
Enable the growth of the ES Canadian business through the identification of new growth opportunities, unique customer partnerships and development of business plans to support the Canada ES P&L goals by leveraging understanding of the current healthcare environment and SHS portfolio of products and services
Identify and lead strategic initiatives such as Value Partnerships as well as enabling growth within Canada.
Maintain a strong prospect pipeline and provide regular forecasts, ensuring a high level of accuracy.
Ensure operational delivery meets or exceeds financial forecasts while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.
Identify and pursue business development opportunities, including those beyond the current portfolio or Business Area. Proactively evolve the Enterprise Services portfolio to address and stimulate market demand.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with key customers.
Collaborate with DX, Varian, and IM sales teams, as well as the NAM Enterprise Services team, to engage public and private sector customers and pursue new business opportunities.
Lead the development of high-quality, competitive tender responses and business proposals, aligned to customer timelines.
Design and deliver compelling customer presentations, solution concepts, and demonstrations.
Provide high-quality sales collateral to the sales team in various formats (e.g., brochures, presentations).
Lead sales negotiations while maintaining strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.
Develop, negotiate, and manage the annual Enterprise Services budget, including monthly forecast reviews.
Maintain strong product knowledge and ensure adherence to quality assurance (QA) and compliance procedures.
Ensure the team is appropriately resourced to support both pre- and post-sales activities.
Represent the organization at congresses and customer events, contributing to event concept development and delivering presentations or lectures.
Foster strong, two-way communication with internal sales teams, the NAM Enterprise Services team, and Business Area/Line development teams to optimize the sales and product portfolio. This includes sharing customer feedback and market insights.

Qualifications

15+ years of healthcare operations leadership experience; sales and business development experience is beneficial
Minimum a relevant Bachelor's degree
Strong technical understanding of the Enterprise Services portfolio and solutions and Canadian consulting market
Deep knowledge of the Canadian medical device market and public sector procurement processes
Strategic, innovative, and lateral thinker with the ability to approach challenges creatively
Proven ability to plan and organize effectively to deliver against both short- and long-term objectives
Strong numerical and commercial acumen
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Highly developed interpersonal and relationship management skills
Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and manage teams effectively within a matrix environment by empowering managers and individual contributors
Advanced sales and negotiation capabilities
Confident presenter, with the ability to engage large audiences
Ability to perform effectively under pressure and manage competing priorities
Bilingual in French and English considered an asset

#INDDNP

Who we are:
We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

How we work:
When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

To find out more about Siemens Healthineers' businesses, please visit our company page at Siemens Healthineers Canada.

 Factors that may affect expected compensation include geography/market, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Siemens Healthineers offers a variety of health and wellness benefits including a flexible benefits plan, Defined Contribution Pension Plan, Registered Retirement Savings Plan matching contributions, plus a competitive paid time off program including vacation, company holidays, sick leave, and parental leave (all subject to eligibility requirements).

This information is provided per required laws and regulations. Applicants should apply via Siemens Healthineers external or internal careers site.

Unless prohibited by law, position must meet all Vendor Credentialing requirements necessary to have full client access and must continue to meet those requirements during the course of employment in this position. These requirements vary by client and may include, but are not limited to: Proof of valid identification (photo, driver's license, SIN) Criminal background checks, Immunizations and Annual TB testing Healthcare training.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:
Siemens Healthineers is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. While we appreciate all applications we receive, we advise that only candidates under consideration will be contacted.

Accessibility:
Siemens Healthineers is committed to excellence in serving all employees and customers, including people with disabilities. Siemens Healthineers will strive to ensure that policies and procedures established with respect to the provisions of its goods and services to persons with disabilities are consistent with the principles of dignity, independence, integration and equal opportunity as provided in the Accessibilities for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005. Siemens Healthineers will continue to attempt to meet the needs of all its customers, including but not limited to persons with disabilities, in an effective and timely manner.

Siemens Healthineers does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other company location. Siemens Healthineers is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
